# atlassian_confluence_space_role (Data Source)

Reads one tenant-wide Confluence space role by ID.

## Required OAuth scopes

- `read:space.permission:confluence`

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "atlassian_confluence_space_role" "example" {
  id = "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Tenant-specific space role ID.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description of the space role.
- `name` (String) Name of the space role.
- `space_permissions` (Set of String) Space permission IDs included in the role.
- `type` (String) Role type returned by Confluence.
